---
title: "Failure analyses"
---

No outcome-bearing paired EXP-0001 experiment exists. The completed T07 artifact smoke
is infrastructure evidence only. T09 Retry 2 produced one descriptive calibration
attempt but no realized pair or checkpoint, so its score is not evidence for either
condition's superiority and no EXP-0001 outcome is assigned.

## T09 V3 runtime-preflight stop

On 2026-08-13, the single authorized `PLAN-EXP0001-PILOT-V3` host stopped before the
empirical boundary. Rebuilding the pinned T07 runtime produced a container identity
different from the frozen required digest, while no verified loadable copy of the
frozen image was retained. Substitution would have changed the runtime contract, so
the harness failed closed. No condition or evaluator attempt ran; calls, tokens,
browser actions, scores, and OpenAI cost are all zero.

The exact Lambda host was terminated after the available preflight evidence was
sealed. Provider evidence verifies terminal/absent state, zero remaining T09
instances, and restored security state. This is a preflight infrastructure failure,
not evidence about either SiRA condition or EXP-0001. A future attempt requires the
exact image or a separately reviewed runtime requalification and fresh authorization.

`PLAN-EXP0001-PILOT-V4` was that separately reviewed Retry 2 policy. It preserved the
V3 record and accepted one replacement image only after functional qualification.

## T09 V4 post-entry finalizer stop

On 2026-08-13, V4 replacement image `sha256:e2603f5a…` passed the pinned runtime,
browser, evaluator-fixture, command-pair, credential, and model-metadata gates and was
frozen before empirical entry. Task A reactive ran exactly once: process exit zero,
task completed, exact evaluator valid, descriptive score 0.0, 52 model calls, 121,900
tokens, 13 browser actions, and USD 0.3626425 OpenAI cost.

The frozen host finalizer then failed twice before evaluator completion. First, it
looked for `output_root` at the command manifest's top level even though the frozen
manifest stored it under `permitted_condition_owned`. Second, its evaluator-only
Python environment lacked a dependency that the preflight-qualified SiRA-Python plus
evaluator-overlay environment contained. A one-time, network-disabled reconstruction
used the retained immutable raw prefix and exact pinned evaluator to preserve the
already-consumed attempt; it made no new model request, browser action, or condition
attempt. That recovery was not a scientific retry.

The corrected reconstruction invocation was not the frozen later-attempt command.
Continuing would therefore have changed post-entry configuration. The campaign stopped
before Task A simulative; no first-pair checkpoint or Task B attempt exists. Evidence
was transferred, temporary secrets and owned containers were removed, and the exact
provider host is terminal/absent with zero T09 instances and restored security. This
is a control-plane stop, not a negative result for either SiRA condition.

## T09 V6 post-entry raw-seal stop

On 2026-08-14, V6 imported and fully qualified the retained replacement image, then
Task A reactive crossed empirical entry once. It retained 20 task-model calls, 38,779
tokens, five requested browser actions, and four post-action results. A 234,479,616-
byte core artifact expanded the attempt tree beyond its 67,108,864-byte hard cap. The
host stopped the container with exit 143; the immutable raw-complete seal then failed
closed. Task completion, answer, evaluator validity, and score are unavailable—not
zero. The remaining three conditions did not run, so no pair or checkpoint exists.

Both hosts are terminal or absent, zero T09 instances and restored security are
verified. Post-termination review preserved all four original archive files byte-
exact and added one private sidecar containing the single manifest-owned member that
aggregate staging omitted. The reconstructed union reloads the frozen runtime; a
separate source-bound receipt distinguishes provider preflight, empirical time, and
cumulative billable time without changing the provider closeout. Public raw release
remains blocked. This is an infrastructure-invalid unscored attempt, not scientific
evidence against either condition.

Future entries will distinguish:

- infrastructure-invalid runs;
- contract/schema failures;
- source-parity discrepancies;
- null or negative scientific outcomes;
- safety or authorization stops; and
- retracted interpretations.

Each entry must identify the root cause, affected evidence, corrective action, and whether rerun is permitted. A dependency error is not a negative model result.
